title: Pirates and Treasure
intro: [excited] Ahoy, mateys! Welcome aboard a swashbuckling Disney Jeopardy! Tonight it's pirates and buried treasure, from the Black Pearl to the parks. [laughs] Answer right and the gold is yours. Answer wrong and you walk the plank.

art.prompt: An old wooden treasure chest overflowing with gold coins and jewels on a moonlit tropical beach, a tall ship with black sails anchored offshore, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Parley!
categories.intro: We begin with the Pirates of the Caribbean films. [chuckles] You've clearly heard of them.

art.prompt: A tall pirate ship with tattered black sails gliding through misty moonlit Caribbean waters, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This tentacle-bearded captain of the Flying Dutchman keeps his heart locked in a chest.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Davy Jones! He plays the pipe organ with his tentacles. [laughs] Talented guy.

clues.clue: At the start of The Curse of the Black Pearl, Will Turner works at this trade.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a blacksmith! He practices sword fighting three hours a day. [chuckles] Jack tells him he needs to get out more.

clues.clue: Barbossa's cursed crew are revealed as skeletons whenever they step into this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is moonlight! You best start believing in ghost stories, Miss Turner. You're in one.

clues.clue: This Rolling Stones guitarist plays Jack Sparrow's father, Captain Teague.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Keith Richards! Johnny Depp based Jack partly on him, so it was the perfect bit of casting.

clues.clue: This East India Trading Company lord makes Davy Jones and the pirates miserable in Dead Man's Chest and At World's End.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lord Cutler Beckett. 'It's just good business,' he says, right before his ship explodes. [chuckles]

categories.title: Scallywags
categories.intro: Pirates sail all over the Disney universe. Let's meet the other scallywags.

art.prompt: A rocky island lagoon with a skull-shaped rock, a small rowboat and a treasure map pinned to a palm tree, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Captain Hook's hand was eaten by this animal, which now follows him around ticking.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is a crocodile! He swallowed a clock, so you can always hear him coming. Tick tock.

clues.clue: In Treasure Planet, Jim Hawkins befriends this half-robot cook, the ship's secret pirate.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is John Silver! A space version of Long John Silver, with a pet blob named Morph.

clues.clue: In this Disney Junior series, a young pirate crew in Never Land keeps outsmarting Captain Hook.
clues.answer: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
accept: jake and the never land pirates
choices: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jake and the Never Land Pirates! Yo ho, let's go! Gold doubloons for everyone.

clues.clue: In Moana, these tiny coconut-armored pirates attack Moana and Maui's canoe.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Kakamora! [laughs] Cute little coconuts... with blow darts.

clues.clue: In Treasure Planet, Jim sails across the galaxy aboard this solar-sail ship.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the RLS Legacy! RLS stands for Robert Louis Stevenson, author of Treasure Island. [chuckles] Clever.

categories.title: X Marks the Zoom
categories.intro: Zoom category! We start close on a treasured object. Name the Disney film it comes from.

art.prompt: An old parchment treasure map with a red X, a brass spyglass and a compass on a wooden captain's desk lit by a lantern, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This object comes from which Disney film?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Peter Pan! That shiny hook and feathered hat belong to Captain Hook.

media.prompt: A shiny silver hook prosthetic and a large red feathered captain's hat on a ship's deck, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This object comes from which film franchise?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean! Jack's compass doesn't point north. It points to what you want most.

clues.clue: This treasure comes from which Disney film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! The heart of Te Fiti. [gasps] Maui stole it, and it started all the trouble.

media.prompt: A small smooth green stone with a glowing spiral pattern resting in an open palm-sized seashell by the ocean, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This treasure comes from which Disney film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Treasure Planet! That golden sphere projects a holographic star map. Way cooler than a paper one.

media.prompt: A small golden sphere covered in intricate etched rings, glowing and projecting green holographic stars above it, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This treasure comes from which Disney film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Rescuers! That's the Devil's Eye diamond, hidden in a skull in a flooded pirate cave. [whispers] Nerd points for you.

media.prompt: A huge glittering diamond wedged inside the mouth of a stone skull in a dark flooded cave, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales
categories.intro: To the parks! Real photos of pirate places around the Disney parks. Keep your hands inside the boat.

art.prompt: A lantern-lit boat dock in a misty bayou at night, fireflies glowing and an old wooden rowboat waiting, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This classic boat ride, seen here, opened at Disneyland in 1967. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean! It was the last ride Walt Disney personally oversaw. He died three months before it opened.

clues.clue: Walt himself designed this river island, which got a pirate makeover at Disneyland in 2007 as Pirate's Lair. Name it.
accept: pirate's lair on tom sawyer island
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tom Sawyer Island! [chuckles] Rafts only. No swimming, no matter how pirate you feel.

clues.clue: This pirate-themed land, with a full-size ship in its harbor, opened in 2016 at which Disney park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Shanghai Disneyland! Treasure Cove is home to Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure.

clues.clue: Disneyland Paris's Pirates of the Caribbean, seen here, sails in this land, home of Skull Rock too.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Adventureland! It opened with the park in 1992. [laughs] Same pirates, but with better croissants nearby.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Pirates fortress, seen here, is inspired by El Morro, a real fort in this Caribbean city.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is San Juan, Puerto Rico! The real Castillo San Felipe del Morro dates to the 1500s. History and pirates!

categories.title: Ahoy, Hollywood!
categories.intro: Our fan category is all about the stars who played pirates. [chuckles] Name the actor.

art.prompt: A dark theater stage dressed as a pirate ship deck, a spotlight on a treasure chest and an empty director's chair, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This actor swaggers through the Pirates films as Captain Jack Sparrow.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Johnny Depp! He earned an Oscar nomination for the very first film.

clues.clue: This actress plays Elizabeth Swann.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Keira Knightley! She was only 17 when the first film was shot.

clues.clue: This actor plays the blacksmith-turned-pirate Will Turner.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Orlando Bloom! He went from an elf in Middle-earth straight to the high seas.

clues.clue: This British actor gives voice and motion capture to Davy Jones.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bill Nighy! He wore a gray motion-capture suit with dots on it. [laughs] Very glamorous.

clues.clue: In Dead Men Tell No Tales, this Oscar winner plays the ghostly Captain Salazar.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Javier Bardem! His hair floats like he's always underwater. [whispers] Creepy.
